title: Minimum outdoor air not maintained in occupied mode
symptoms: CO2 trends high; spaces feel stuffy; OA damper command changes but measured OA flow stays low
likely_root_causes: Min OA setpoint incorrect; OA damper actuator not stroking; OA flow station miscalibrated or installed poorly; conflicting economizer logic; fan airflow estimate wrong
field_checks: Command OA damper to 0/50/100% and verify physical position; compare OA flow station to spot traverse; verify occupied mode min OA setpoint and units; check economizer enable conditions; confirm supply fan airflow signal source
recommended_actions: Correct setpoints and units; repair/rewire actuator; recalibrate or relocate flow station; update economizer logic to respect minimum OA; retest CO2 response
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the required minimum outdoor air rate for AHU-1 during occupied mode (L/s or CFM) and whether minimum OA must be maintained during economizer operation. Provide the intended sequence if different from current programming.

title: Outdoor air damper moves opposite of command or saturates early
symptoms: Damper indicated 100% but visibly near closed (or vice versa); mixed air temperature not responding as expected
likely_root_causes: Actuator wired in reverse; stroke limits set incorrectly; linkage slipping; controller output scaled wrong; actuator torque insufficient
field_checks: Trend command vs feedback; visually confirm damper position at multiple commands; check actuator rotation direction and end switches; inspect linkage and set screws; verify controller output scaling
recommended_actions: Correct wiring/polarity; set proper stroke limits; repair linkage; correct scaling; replace actuator if torque insufficient
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the damper actuator type and required fail position for the OA damper on AHU-2, and whether a calibrated position feedback signal is required by design.

title: Mixed air temperature unstable or hunting during economizer
symptoms: Mixed air temp oscillates; supply air temp unstable; dampers constantly moving; comfort complaints
likely_root_causes: PID tuning too aggressive; sensor location causing stratification; low airflow at minimum speed; economizer changeover logic unstable; sensor filtering missing
field_checks: Review trends for MAT, OAT, RAT, damper position; verify MAT sensor placement and shielding; temporarily fix damper position and observe MAT stability; check minimum fan speed and airflow; check economizer enable/disable thresholds and deadbands
recommended_actions: Retune loops and add deadbands; relocate or average MAT sensing; add sensor filtering; adjust minimum fan speed; revise economizer logic for stable changeover
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the intended economizer changeover strategy (dry-bulb/enthalpy) and required deadbands for AHU-3. Provide the control narrative if available.

title: Preheat coil freeze protection trips or is ineffective
symptoms: Low-temp alarms; preheat valve fully open but temperature still drops; occasional coil freeze risk; nuisance trips
likely_root_causes: Freeze stat incorrectly located or wired; valve stuck or undersized; glycol concentration insufficient; OA damper leaking; incorrect sequence during warm-up; sensor scaling errors
field_checks: Verify freeze stat placement and continuity test; check valve stroke and actuator operation; confirm glycol concentration (if applicable); check OA damper leakage at 0% command; trend entering air temp and valve command during warm-up
recommended_actions: Correct freeze stat location/wiring; repair/replace valve/actuator; adjust warm-up sequence; reduce leakage; verify glycol protection and setpoints; retest under cold conditions
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the required freeze protection strategy for the preheat coil (setpoints; actions; damper position; fan shutdown logic) and the design leaving-air temperature minimum.

title: Cooling coil not dehumidifying; humidity remains high
symptoms: Space RH stays high; supply air temperature meets setpoint but RH does not; condensate minimal despite humid weather
likely_root_causes: Chilled water valve not opening fully; CHW supply temperature too warm; airflow too high for latent removal; sensor placement issues; reheat/dehumidification sequence missing
field_checks: Trend CHW supply/return temps; verify valve stroke and ΔP across valve; measure supply airflow vs design; check RH sensor calibration; verify dehumidification logic (SAT reset limits; coil leaving temp constraints)
recommended_actions: Fix valve/actuator; adjust CHW plant setpoints if allowed; reduce airflow or adjust SAT targets within limits; correct sensor calibration; implement dehumidification sequence and reheat coordination
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the design humidity control requirement (target RH; max RH; design latent conditions) and whether AHU-4 is expected to perform active dehumidification or rely on downstream control.

title: Supply fan VFD hunting; static pressure unstable
symptoms: Supply duct static pressure swings; VFD speed oscillates; VAVs noisy; occasional high static alarms
likely_root_causes: Static pressure sensor location poor; PID tuning unstable; minimum speed too low; sensor tubing leaks; pressure setpoint reset logic conflicting
field_checks: Inspect static pressure pickup location and tubing; check for kinks/leaks; trend static pressure, VFD speed, and setpoint; temporarily fix setpoint and tune loop; verify minimum speed and anti-windup settings
recommended_actions: Relocate sensor to representative point; repair tubing; retune PID and add rate limits; adjust minimum fan speed; simplify/sequence setpoint reset logic
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the intended static pressure control location and reset strategy for AHU-5 (e.g., based on VAV damper position) and any limits on fan speed.

title: Filter differential pressure reading incorrect or negative
symptoms: DP shows negative or near zero despite loaded filters; alarms not triggering; maintenance cannot rely on readings
likely_root_causes: DP tubes reversed; pickup ports clogged; tubing leaks; sensor range wrong; sensor zero not set; static pressure effects at taps
field_checks: Confirm high/low ports connected correctly; check tubing for leaks and clogs; verify sensor range and wiring; perform zero check with both ports equalized; compare to handheld manometer
recommended_actions: Correct tubing and ports; clean/replace taps; calibrate sensor; adjust range; implement reasonable alarm thresholds with delay
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the required filter alarm thresholds (pre-filter and final filter) and whether DP should be trended for predictive maintenance.

title: Condensate drain overflow or pan alarm during cooling
symptoms: Water in unit; overflow switch trips; downstream duct wet; musty odor risk
likely_root_causes: Trap improperly sized; missing trap primer; drain slope inadequate; negative pressure causing blow-through; drain line blockage
field_checks: Verify trap geometry and depth vs unit static pressure; check drain line slope and cleanout access; flush drain and confirm flow; check if pan sits level; confirm overflow switch wiring
recommended_actions: Correct trap design; add cleanout and proper slope; clear blockage; level pan; verify overflow shutdown interlock and alarms
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the required condensate trap configuration for AHU-4 given the unit static pressure (provide design static if known) and whether an overflow shutoff is required.

title: Heat recovery wheel/plate not operating as intended
symptoms: Expected preconditioning not observed; wheel speed not changing; cross-leakage suspected; frost alarms in cold weather
likely_root_causes: Wheel drive fault; bypass damper stuck; controls not enabling; seal leakage; purge sector mis-set; frost control sequence incorrect
field_checks: Check wheel rotation and speed feedback; verify bypass damper position physically; trend enable signals and interlocks; measure supply/exhaust temps across wheel; inspect seals and purge sector; review frost control logic
recommended_actions: Repair drive and sensors; correct bypass actuator; enable proper sequence; adjust purge sector/seals; implement stable frost prevention and defrost logic; retest under cold conditions
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the intended energy recovery control strategy (wheel speed modulation vs on/off; bypass conditions; frost control) and acceptable cross-leakage limitations for AHU-6.

title: VAV airflow reading inconsistent with measured flow
symptoms: Flow reading high/low vs hood measurement; box does not meet min/max CFM; comfort complaints
likely_root_causes: Flow sensor tubing issues; k-factor wrong; controller scaling incorrect; straight duct requirements not met; internal pickup damaged
field_checks: Inspect tubing connections and orientation; verify k-factor and box size match controller config; compare multiple measurement methods; check for upstream disturbances; check calibration procedure and sensor condition
recommended_actions: Correct k-factor/scaling; re-route/repair tubing; follow manufacturer calibration; add straightening or relocate measurement location; retest min/max and tracking
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the specified VAV box model/size and required min/max airflow setpoints for VAV-12, including any diversity or occupancy-based adjustments.

title: VAV damper stuck, reversed, or not tracking setpoint
symptoms: Damper command changes but position does not; box saturates; room temp drifts; noisy airflow
likely_root_causes: Actuator failed; linkage slipping; reverse acting command; mechanical obstruction; controller output limits wrong
field_checks: Command damper to multiple positions and verify movement; inspect linkage and blade for obstruction; trend command vs position feedback; verify actuator power and signal type; check output scaling and limits
recommended_actions: Repair/replace actuator; fix linkage; correct signal direction/scaling; remove obstruction; validate control response under load
rfi_template_question: Please confirm damper actuator requirements (fail position; signal type; position feedback needed) for VAV-07 and whether it is intended to be direct-acting or reverse-acting in the sequence.

title: Reheat valve stuck open causing overheating or excessive energy use
symptoms: Zone overheats in cooling season; reheat command 0% but leaving air temp high; energy consumption elevated
likely_root_causes: Valve installed backwards; actuator not calibrated; valve leaking; control logic calling heat due to sensor error; hot water loop DP too high causing leakage
field_checks: Verify valve flow direction and labeling; command valve closed/open and measure leaving air temp response; check actuator stroke; trend heating demand vs room sensor reading; measure HW supply temp and DP
recommended_actions: Correct valve orientation; repair/replace actuator or valve; recalibrate; adjust control logic and deadbands; add DP control if required
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the intended reheat control sequence (deadband; reheat lockout conditions) and whether reheat should be disabled during economizer or mild outdoor conditions.

title: Room temperature oscillation due to control tuning or bad sensing
symptoms: Room temp swings around setpoint; frequent heating/cooling toggling; occupants complain
likely_root_causes: PID parameters too aggressive; sensor location near diffuser or exterior wall; short cycling due to tight deadband; incorrect units or offset; averaging logic missing
field_checks: Trend room temp, setpoint, heating/cooling outputs; check sensor placement and exposure; compare with handheld thermometer; widen deadband temporarily; check control loop update rate
recommended_actions: Retune loop; relocate/replace sensor; implement sensible deadband and minimum on/off times; correct offsets; consider averaging multiple sensors in large zones
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the required comfort deadband and whether the room sensor location is approved by design (or if relocation is permitted).

title: VAV minimum airflow too low causing poor ventilation or pressurization drift
symptoms: CO2 rises quickly; odors; room goes negative/positive unexpectedly; diffuser throw inadequate
likely_root_causes: Min flow set too low; occupancy assumptions wrong; demand-controlled ventilation not enabled; airflow station under-reading; schedule misapplied
field_checks: Verify min flow setpoint and units; compare CO2 and occupancy patterns; check DCV enable and CO2 sensor calibration; confirm airflow measurement accuracy; verify schedule applied to the zone
recommended_actions: Adjust min flow; enable DCV with safe limits; recalibrate sensors; update schedules; retest ventilation performance under expected occupancy
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the design minimum ventilation for this zone (per occupancy and code) and whether demand-controlled ventilation is intended for this space.

title: Zone cannot meet cooling due to low airflow or incorrect max flow limit
symptoms: Zone warm; VAV at max command; measured airflow below expected; supply static pressure seems ok
likely_root_causes: Max airflow set too low; balancing damper too restricted; downstream duct leakage; box size mismatch; fan static insufficient at peak; damper travel limited
field_checks: Verify max setpoint vs design; measure airflow and compare to terminal rating; inspect balancing dampers; check duct leakage/noise; confirm damper travel; verify upstream static pressure at peak
recommended_actions: Correct max setpoints; adjust balancing dampers; fix leakage; verify box sizing vs design; coordinate fan/static adjustments if needed
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the design cooling airflow requirement for VAV-03 and whether the installed box size matches the scheduled equipment in the drawings.

title: Chilled water loop low ΔT (return temperature too low)
symptoms: CHW return temperature unexpectedly low; chiller plant efficiency poor; valves mostly open; difficulty meeting loads
likely_root_causes: Coils over-flowing; three-way valves or bypass mixing; CHW supply too cold causing low coil ΔT; control logic driving excessive flow; coil control valves oversized
field_checks: Trend CHW supply/return temps and coil valve positions; identify bypass/three-way valves; check coil leaving air temp vs valve position; spot-check flow rates if meters exist; verify sequence for reset and limits
recommended_actions: Correct bypass issues; adjust coil valve sizing/characterization; implement CHW temperature reset; tune valve control to avoid over-flow; verify commissioning targets for ΔT
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the intended CHW design ΔT and whether any three-way valves or bypass arrangements are permitted in the design for this project.

title: CHW pump VFD hunting or unstable differential pressure control
symptoms: DP setpoint swings; pumps ramp up/down; coil valves noisy; occasional low flow alarms
likely_root_causes: DP sensor placement poor; PID tuning unstable; min speed too low; sensor noise; multiple pumps sequencing conflicts; air entrainment
field_checks: Inspect DP sensor taps and tubing; trend DP, setpoint, pump speed, pump staging; verify minimum speed and ramp rates; check air separator and venting; confirm pump lead/lag logic
recommended_actions: Relocate DP sensor; retune control with rate limits; adjust minimum speed; clean up staging logic; address air in system; verify valve authority and noise
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the required CHW DP control location and reset strategy (e.g., based on most-open valve) and any minimum flow requirements for the pumps/chillers.

title: DP sensor reading incorrect due to installation or tubing issues
symptoms: DP reading stuck or fluctuating; does not match handheld gauge; control loop unstable
likely_root_causes: Taps reversed; tubing leaks or blockage; sensor range wrong; sensor not bled; taps too close causing noise; air in lines
field_checks: Verify high/low taps orientation; inspect tubing for leaks/kinks; bleed sensor lines; compare to handheld DP at same points; check sensor range and wiring; confirm taps located in stable flow region
recommended_actions: Correct taps and tubing; bleed lines; calibrate/replace sensor; relocate taps if needed; stabilize readings then retune control
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the intended hydronic DP measurement points for control and whether remote DP reset is required for this building.

title: Chiller enable/disable sequencing not coordinating with BAS schedules
symptoms: Chillers start at wrong times; short cycling; pumps run after hours; space temps drift due to late start
likely_root_causes: Schedule/holiday config wrong; interlocks missing; min run-time not enforced; incorrect demand calculation; plant lead/lag logic flawed
field_checks: Review BAS schedules and holidays; trend start/stop events vs occupancy; verify interlocks (flow proving; isolation valves); check minimum run/off times; verify demand logic inputs (OAT; loads; valve position)
recommended_actions: Correct schedules and holidays; add minimum runtime and lockouts; fix lead/lag logic; validate interlocks; test start-up and shutdown sequences
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the plant operating schedule requirements (including holidays) and any constraints on chiller minimum run/off times or staging logic.

title: Air in chilled water system causing poor heat transfer and noise
symptoms: Gurgling/noisy pipes; unstable coil performance; erratic DP; temperature control inconsistent
likely_root_causes: Inadequate venting/air separator performance; fill water procedure incomplete; high points not vented; low static pressure; leaks drawing air
field_checks: Check air separator installation and operation; verify expansion tank charge and system static pressure; vent high points; inspect for leaks; review fill/flush procedure records
recommended_actions: Re-commission venting and air removal; correct static pressure; repair leaks; verify air separator sizing and operation; retest coil stability
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the required system static pressure at the highest point and whether additional manual/automatic vents are specified at high points.

title: BMS point mapping/scaling incorrect (values unrealistic)
symptoms: Temperatures show 200°C or -40°C; valve position 0–100% but stuck; alarms nonsensical
likely_root_causes: Wrong BACnet object mapped; scaling factor incorrect; units mismatch; analog input type wrong; point names swapped; polarity errors
field_checks: Perform point-to-point verification; compare BAS values with local controller; check engineering units and scaling; verify write commands change outputs; verify end-to-end sensor signal type
recommended_actions: Correct mapping table; update scaling and units; fix point naming; retest point-to-point; document the final I/O list
rfi_template_question: Please provide the latest control I/O schedule and confirm engineering units and scaling requirements for all temperature and flow-related points in this system.

title: Sequences of operation implemented differently than design intent
symptoms: System behaves logically but not per design (e.g., SAT reset missing; lockouts ignored); owner expectations not met
likely_root_causes: Outdated control narrative used; missed addenda; field changes not reflected; programmer assumptions; incomplete handoff from design team
field_checks: Compare current logic to control narrative; identify deltas and list them; trend key states to show behavior; review addenda/RFIs; confirm stakeholder expectations (owner/commissioning)
recommended_actions: Create a sequence delta report; request design confirmation; update programming to match approved intent; re-test functional performance; archive approved final narrative
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the approved sequence of operation for this system (including all addenda/RFI responses) and identify any acceptable deviations for field conditions.

title: Trend logs missing, wrong interval, or wrong point list for commissioning
symptoms: Commissioning cannot verify performance; data too sparse; missing key points; trends overwritten too fast
likely_root_causes: Trend configuration incomplete; sampling interval too long; limited historian capacity; wrong points selected; retention policy too short
field_checks: Review required commissioning trend list; verify sampling intervals; verify retention length; spot-check timestamp accuracy; confirm historian storage capacity; export sample trend files
recommended_actions: Configure trend templates per system; adjust sampling/retention; add key points (setpoints, commands, feedback); validate exports; document trend setup for handover
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the required trend point list, sampling intervals, and minimum retention period needed for commissioning sign-off and owner operations.

title: Alarm flooding or nuisance alarms during startup/commissioning
symptoms: Hundreds of alarms; operators ignore important ones; commissioning slowed due to noise
likely_root_causes: Alarm thresholds too tight; missing delays; wrong priority; equipment not in service but alarming; stale points
field_checks: Review top alarm sources; check thresholds/delays/priorities; confirm commissioning mode or suppression rules; validate point quality; test alarm behavior with controlled disturbances
recommended_actions: Implement commissioning alarm suppression rules; set sensible delays and priorities; refine thresholds; clear stale alarms; establish an alarm philosophy for handover
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the alarm priority and delay requirements for this system, and whether a temporary commissioning alarm suppression mode is acceptable.

title: Air balancing cannot achieve design flows due to insufficient fan static pressure
symptoms: Many terminals below target; balancing dampers fully open; fan at high speed; static near limit
likely_root_causes: Fan design static not achieved; duct restrictions; fire/smoke dampers partially closed; filters too restrictive; VFD limits; incorrect sheaves or rotation
field_checks: Measure fan total/static pressure and compare to schedule; verify fan rotation; inspect filters and dampers; check VFD max speed limit; look for constrictions and closed dampers
recommended_actions: Remove restrictions; correct fan setup and VFD limits; verify damper positions; adjust sheaves if allowed; revisit design assumptions if necessary; re-test TAB
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the required fan total and static pressure at design flow, and whether any field changes (filters; duct routing; dampers) require an updated airside calculation.

title: Airflow measurement stations installed incorrectly (orientation/straight runs)
symptoms: Flow station readings unreliable; large variance between methods; control loop unstable when based on flow
likely_root_causes: Insufficient straight duct upstream/downstream; flow station installed backwards; turbulence from fittings; sensors not seated; incorrect averaging
field_checks: Verify installation orientation and location relative to fittings; compare station to pitot traverse; inspect sensor probes; check manufacturer requirements; evaluate turbulence sources
recommended_actions: Relocate station to suitable straight run; correct orientation; add flow conditioning if needed; recalibrate; avoid using unstable readings for critical control until fixed
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the acceptable airflow measurement accuracy for this application and whether relocating the flow station is permissible if current location cannot meet requirements.

title: Terminal unit balancing conflicts with control setpoints (TAB vs BAS)
symptoms: TAB setpoints keep changing; airflow drifts after balancing; commissioning repeats
likely_root_causes: BAS overrides active; setpoints tied to schedules; demand-control adjusting; integrator changes during TAB; wrong operating mode during balancing
field_checks: Verify BAS is in TAB mode and overrides locked; confirm schedules/occupancy states; trend min/max setpoints during TAB; coordinate with controls contractor; document final setpoints
recommended_actions: Use a dedicated TAB mode with fixed setpoints; freeze schedules; coordinate change control; record final values; verify stable after returning to auto
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the required TAB mode procedure (fixed setpoints; overrides; schedules) and who has authority to change setpoints during TAB.

title: Cleanroom pressure cascade unstable; differential pressure alarms frequent
symptoms: Room-to-room ΔP fluctuates; door openings trigger long recovery; alarms during normal operations; particle control concerns
likely_root_causes: Control loops too aggressive; sensor placement near doors or turbulence; supply/exhaust tracking not coordinated; door interlocks missing; airflow too low at minimum
field_checks: Trend ΔP, supply/exhaust flows, and control outputs; verify sensor placement and tubing; test door event recovery time; check supply/exhaust tracking logic and limits; verify minimum airflow during occupied/unoccupied modes
recommended_actions: Relocate/average sensors; retune loops with deadbands and recovery logic; implement supply/exhaust tracking with limits; adjust minimum airflows; validate recovery times and alarm delays
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the required cleanroom pressure cascade targets (ΔP setpoints and tolerances) and acceptable recovery time after door openings for each room in the suite.

title: Cleanroom room differential pressure sensor drifts or disagrees with handheld gauge
symptoms: ΔP sensor reading slowly drifts; alarms despite stable airflow; inconsistent with portable manometer
likely_root_causes: Sensor not zeroed; tubing leaks/kinks; sensor range too wide/narrow; port placement in turbulent zones; temperature effects; reference side exposed to pressure swings
field_checks: Perform zero check (equalize ports) and record offset; inspect tubing for leaks and kinks; compare to handheld manometer at same ports; verify sensor range and mounting; check reference port location and shielding
recommended_actions: Calibrate/replace sensor; fix tubing; relocate pressure taps; add filtering/averaging; set alarm delays to avoid nuisance without masking true failures
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the required accuracy class and range for cleanroom differential pressure sensors and the approved tap locations (room vs corridor reference).

title: Supply/exhaust tracking fails to maintain pressure during mode changes
location_scope: Cleanroom suite / mode change (occupied to unoccupied)
symptoms: Room goes negative/positive during mode transitions; exhaust ramps late; supply stays high; interlocks not behaving
likely_root_causes: Mode change logic missing sequencing; exhaust VFD limits; dampers slow; incorrect minimum airflow; incorrect priority between temperature and pressurization; interlock signals delayed
field_checks: Trend mode state, supply/exhaust commands, ΔP, and damper positions; test transition sequence step-by-step; verify VFD ramp limits; check damper stroke speed; validate minimums for each mode
recommended_actions: Implement staged transitions (exhaust lead/lag); set ramp rates and delays; ensure pressurization has priority during transitions; adjust minimums; re-test and document sequences
rfi_template_question: Please confirm the intended operating modes (occupied/unoccupied/setback) and the required supply/exhaust sequencing and priorities during mode transitions for cleanroom pressurization control.
